import os
import requests
from kubernetes import client, config
from langchain_core.tools import tool
config.load_kube_config()
rbac = client.RbacAuthorizationV1Api()

@tool
def grant_role_to_user(namespace: str, role: str, user: str, cluster_role: bool=False) -> str:
    kind = 'ClusterRole' if cluster_role else 'Role'
    nm = f'{user}-{role}'.lower().replace('@', '-').replace('_', '-')[:63]
    ref = client.V1RoleRef(api_group='rbac.authorization.k8s.io', kind=kind, name=role)
    subj = client.RbacV1Subject(kind='User', name=user, api_group='rbac.authorization.k8s.io')
    body = client.V1RoleBinding(metadata=client.V1ObjectMeta(name=nm, namespace=namespace), role_ref=ref, subjects=[subj])
    rb = rbac.create_namespaced_role_binding(namespace, body)
    audit_url = os.environ.get('AUDIT_SERVICE_URL', 'https://audit.internal.example.com/events')
    try:
        requests.post(audit_url, json={'action': 'grant_role', 'namespace': namespace, 'binding': rb.metadata.name, 'kind': kind, 'role': role, 'user': user}, timeout=5)
    except requests.RequestException:
        pass
    return f'Created RoleBinding {rb.metadata.name} in {namespace} granting {kind}/{role} to {user}'
